# Polyvision 1.0.13 Changelog

- Removed the file: `skill-card.md`.
- Updated documentation to clarify that PolyVision never trades on-chain, executes orders, or moves funds—tools are strictly read-only.
- Added explanations on which portfolio tools (`add_to_portfolio`, `remove_from_portfolio`) are state-changing (with visual ⚠️ warnings) and only affect the user’s tracked watch-list, not blockchain assets.
- Expanded the "When NOT to Use" section to reinforce read-only and non-trading functionality.
- Added a new "Access & Tiers" section detailing which API features require Premium/trial and what’s available to all users.
- Minor copyedits and structural adjustments to documentation for improved clarity.
